parameters.instructions: Maintenance voice assistant tools. First retrieve guidance, then read back current reported details. The audio.cpp client binds ASR context. Do not invent work-order facts. This workflow creates simulated conversation drafts, not external tickets.

parameters.name: lookup_maintenance_guidance
parameters.description: Retrieve maintenance reporting rules from the local RAG Simple Vector Store. Call this before processing a maintenance report. Does not provide work-order facts.

value.query: ={{ $fromAI('query', 'Maintenance reporting stage or rule to retrieve', 'string') }}

parameters.content:
## Voice assistant → local LLM → n8n MCP tools
Publish this workflow. Production MCP URL: http://192.168.5.151:5678/mcp/ivr-maintenance
The demo uses the same-origin proxy: /n8n/mcp/ivr-maintenance
lookup_maintenance_guidance calls IVR Maintenance Knowledge · RAG Tool; configure its Local Embeddings credential (imported automatically).
Code tools use JavaScript. ASR context is attached by audio.cpp, not generated by the LLM. Reports are simulated drafts reconstructed from conversation history; no external ticket is written. Instance-level MCP/OAuth is not needed for this workflow trigger.
